question: Can a shareholder sell shares directly to an outside buyer without offering them to the other shareholders first?
ground_truth_answer: No. A Shareholder must first offer the shares to the other Shareholders at the same price and on the same terms (right of first refusal) before transferring to a third party.

expected_citations.span_hint: No Shareholder may transfer shares to a third party without first offering them to the other Shareholders at the same price and on the same terms (right of first refusal).
